system_metadata.core_engine: contrast between public greatness and private collapse
system_metadata.primary_emotional_axis: admiration → tension → collapse → fragility → reflective meaning
system_metadata.dominant_audience_state_created: empathetic awe mixed with existential unease
system_metadata.promise_to_viewer: reveal hidden cost behind iconic success and extract life lesson

mechanics.age_usage: implies late-life vulnerability and signals retrospective narrative
mechanics.emotional_intensifier: ‘beyond heartbreaking’ escalates expected sadness into extreme territory
mechanics.subject_selection: globally recognizable figures with perceived strength

click_drivers: violation of expectation (strong figure is fragile)
fear projection (if this can happen to them, it can happen to you)
curiosity_gaps: how did it get this bad
what did they lose or sacrifice

pattern: elevation of subject to symbolic level

techniques.mythologizing_subject: subject framed as archetype (teacher of suffering, symbol of resilience)
techniques.abrupt contrast: sharp pivot from strength to silence/failure
techniques.withheld specifics: delay concrete details to create tension

opening_hook_design.psychological_effect: creates cognitive dissonance that forces continued viewing

timeline_strategy.nonlinear_entry: start at collapse, rewind to origin
timeline_strategy.progressive layering: each phase adds pressure rather than resolving it
timeline_strategy.inevitability_build: events framed as leading toward unavoidable breakdown

sentence_structure.short_interruptions: used for emphasis and emotional hits

direct_questions.structure: personalized hypothetical tied to narrative theme

comment_prompts.placement: after emotional peaks or philosophical questions
comment_prompts.strategy: turn viewer into participant in meaning-making

curiosity_loops: tease future event before explaining past

emotional_engineering.relief_points: temporary recoveries or achievements before deeper fall

authority_and_credibility.effect: grounds emotional narrative in perceived factual reality
authority_and_credibility.balance: alternates between factual density and emotional storytelling

metaphor_system.body_as_system: body breaking down as metaphor for life collapse
metaphor_system.burden_carrying: life framed as weight to carry
metaphor_system.journey_through_darkness: narrative framed as descent and navigation

persuasion_mechanics.implied_worldview: suffering is inevitable and meaningful but has limits

identity_positioning.viewer: someone facing or destined to face hardship
identity_positioning.subject: extreme example of that journey

retention_strategies.layered revelations: each section adds new dimension rather than resolving
retention_strategies.emotional resets: questions or reflective pauses prevent fatigue

components: reframing of entire story as lesson
ending_structure.final_message_pattern: simple, universal rule derived from complex narrative

cta_psychology.not transactional: engagement framed as participation in story

what_is_repeated: body or mind failing under pressure

replication_blueprint.step_1: select a well-known figure with perceived strength
replication_blueprint.step_2: identify a moment of vulnerability or collapse
replication_blueprint.step_3: open with philosophical elevation then disrupt it
replication_blueprint.step_4: rewind to origin and build credibility
replication_blueprint.step_7: deliver collapse in detailed, sensory terms

generation_rules.never_start_with_facts: always start with meaning or identity
generation_rules.delay_core_event: hold key tragedy until tension is built
generation_rules.alternate_scale: switch between global impact and intimate detail
